summary: Feed c070_crc to APM is degraded due to physical layer errors on ingress to packet broker: 11,460 CRC/alignment damaged frames (error rate 0.000812 > threshold 1e-05) on BROKER-A port 1.

findings.root_cause: BROKER-A port 1 (input) is receiving damaged frames with CRC/alignment errors at 0.000812 rate, indicating a faulty cable, bad optic, or duplex mismatch on the link into the broker. 11,460 frames affected.
findings.impact_on_tool: APM will receive corrupted/truncated packets causing inaccurate transaction latency, false retransmission/timeout counts, and incomplete flow records, reducing detection coverage for performance issues.

recommended_fix.why: Physical errors must be fixed at source before broker processing; replace/clean cable/optic and verify speed/duplex autonegotiation to stop CRC errors from corrupting APM visibility.
